title: หนังสือภาพจากเพื่อนบ้าน: เวียดนามอ่านอะไร
summary: สำรวจหนังสือภาพและโลกการอ่านของเด็กเวียดนามกับผู้ก่อตั้ง Slowbooks
presenter: Ms. Nguyen Huu Quynh Huong (Slowbooks Founder)
description:
Have you ever come across a picture book from Vietnam? Or wondered what stories our neighbours are reading?

This year, we’re delighted to welcome Ms. Nguyen Huu Quynh Huong to the Children’s Picture Book Festival!

Quynh Huong is the founder of Slowbooks, a passionate picture book advocate who travels the world sharing her love of picture books. Most recently, she has been nominated for two of the most prestigious international awards in children’s literature: the Astrid Lindgren Memorial Award (ALMA) and the Hans Christian Andersen Award.

Join us for a special talk as we discover the world of Vietnamese picture books and get to know our neighbour a little better through the stories they tell.

The session will be conducted in English
ageRange: ครอบครัว | ผู้สนใจทั่วไป
